Garments ERP Features

Everything your garment business needs.

Quick highlights of the tools included in the HFB Solutions Garments ERP.

01 · PRODUCT MANAGEMENT

📦 Products

Manage product names, categories, brands, sizes, colours, prices, stock and barcodes in one organized place.

02 · CUSTOMER MANAGEMENT

👥 Customers

Keep customer details, phone numbers, addresses and previous balances organized and easy to access.

03 · SALES MANAGEMENT

🛒 Sales

Record sales, quantities, sale prices, customers and totals while keeping transactions organized.

04 · PURCHASE MANAGEMENT

🚚 Purchases

Track purchases, suppliers, quantities, costs and purchase dates for better stock control.

05 · REPORTING

📊 Reports

Review important business information through organized reports and management summaries.

06 · STOCK CONTROL

⚠️ Low Stock

Identify products that need attention so stock can be managed before shortages affect sales.

07 · SETTINGS

⚙️ Company Settings

Keep essential company and system settings organized for day-to-day operations.

08 · ROADMAP

🚀 Coming Features

Additional modules and improvements can be added as the HFB Solutions Garments ERP grows.
